get.description:
Release progress, build logs, service status, domain status and audit events the caller may see. The `event:` name equals the payload's `type`. After a `lagged` event the client missed events and should refetch.

Server-Sent Events. A final `end` event marks a clean end of the stream; an `error` event carries a problem document. Comment lines are heartbeats.
